_comment: Known answer for findings.json in this folder: the outcomes a correct build MUST produce from that recorded document. Nothing here is collected from a host, so the result cannot drift with the machine the test runs on - which is the point. Worked out from the RULES, not from what the code happens to do.

why.TTR-F-001 + TTR-F-002: COR-01: motw and useractivity name C:\Users\a\Downloads\setup.exe
why.TTR-F-003 + TTR-F-004: COR-02: persistence and indicators name C:\Users\a\AppData\Local\Temp\svc.exe

mustNotRise.TTR-F-005: its only path-partner, TTR-F-006, is suppressed by the allowlist - correlating on it would re-raise exactly the noise the allowlist removed
mustNotRise.TTR-F-006: suppressed, so it takes no part at all
mustNotRise.TTR-F-007: names no path, so nothing can agree with it
mustNotRise.TTR-F-008: already an IOC hit at 0.95, which outranks 0.85
